title: tc-api-reference-nav
description: An API reference's side navigation: endpoints grouped by resource, with method badges, a filter and the current page.

description.description: A quiet line under the title: the version, the base URL

groups.description: The resources and their endpoints, in order

current.description: The current endpoint's id – aria-current="page". Set by a click unless a tc-navigate listener calls preventDefault()

query.description: The filter's text. Changed by typing unless a tc-query-change listener calls preventDefault()

showPaths.description: Show each endpoint's path instead of its name. Changed by the Paths switch unless a tc-show-paths-change listener calls preventDefault()

collapsed.description: The ids of closed groups. Changed by opening and closing unless a tc-collapsed-change listener calls preventDefault()

hideFilter.description: Hide the filter field (for a short reference)

id.description: Your key: `current` names it, tc-navigate hands it back

path.description: "/v1/records/{id}" – shown with the Paths switch, and matched by the filter

href.description: Its page; without one the row is a button that only fires tc-navigate

deprecated.description: Struck through and labelled Deprecated; still reachable

ApiMethod.description: An HTTP method; anything else is shown as given, in a neutral badge
